origins.section: A Budget and Yes-or-No Choices Make a 0-1 Knapsack
Four Tests Pin the Requirement Down

gates.says: all 3 of this quiz's answerable readings held and each was taken over the question as it stands

recorded.prompt:q-why-model: Read the whole lesson page, then this question. Using only what the page states, which option does the page decide is correct? Quote or cite the deciding passage.
recorded.outcome:q-why-model: A ranking might be good enough for a single budget row, but the manager's list of rules will grow, and a model can take rules one row at a time.
recorded.prompt:q-no-plan: Read the whole lesson page, then this question. Using only what the page states, which option does the page decide is correct? Quote or cite the deciding passage.
recorded.outcome:q-no-plan: A status other than OPTIMAL or FEASIBLE returns an empty plan with that status, never an exception: "no plan" is an answer the caller must handle (lesson 9.1.1).
recorded.prompt:q-strongest: Read the whole lesson page, then this question. Using only what the page states, which option does the page decide is correct? Quote or cite the deciding passage.
recorded.outcome:q-strongest: The brute-force test is the strongest of the four: it checks the optimum against an answer computed without any solver.

recorded.prompt:q-why-model: Answer ONLY from this question's own text: its stem and its options. Use no knowledge of the subject at all; treat every term as a word you have never met. Pick an option only when the wording itself singles it out: it is longer or more specific than the others, it repeats words from the stem, the others carry absolute terms such as 'always' or 'never', the stem's grammar fits it alone, or it restates the stem. A cue decides only when it clearly singles out one option over every other; a weak cue, or one another option shares, decides nothing. Otherwise answer 'none'. Say which cue decided it, or that none did.
recorded.outcome:q-why-model: from the question's text alone, the reader picked none; the key is 'b'
recorded.because:q-why-model: no cue; stem words like 'model' and 'small season' appear in several options
